problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over a convex set Q. The function f is convex and differentiable throughout E; ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer x⋆∈Q exists.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGapSmooth.lean: Conditions.convex_f, gradient, convex_domain, convex_regularizer, minimizer_feasible, minimizer.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines differentiable f with a possibly nonsmooth convex regularizer ψ and feasibility constraint Q, handled by an exact proximal oracle.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Queries return ∇f(x) exactly at arbitrary x∈E, independently of history and oracle seed. Function-value queries are unavailable.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0 and arbitrary z,v∈E, returns an exact minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal calls share the single fixed oracle budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x∈Q and y∈E with √H1‖y−x‖≤1, f(y)≤f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+[H0+H1(F(x)−F(x⋆))]‖y−x‖². Thus local ambient curvature depends on the composite objective gap. H0,H1≥0; H1=0 makes the model global.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space. Public inputs include H0,H1,R,Δ,ε,x0, with R,Δ,ε>0, ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R and F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ. The minimizer and optimum value are not supplied. No bounded domain or bounded sublevel-set radius is assumed.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point x must belong to Q and satisfy F(x)−F(x⋆)≤ε for a minimizer x⋆∈Q.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within the fixed supplied oracle budget.

descriptionHtml:
Composite Minimization with Gap Smoothness

We consider minimizing F=f+ψ over a convex set Q in a real Hilbert space E, where f,ψ:E→R, f is differentiable and convex, and ψ is convex on Q. A local quadratic upper model for f depends on the objective gap to a minimizer x⋆∈Q. A given feasible starting point has bounded distance and objective gap to x⋆. The oracle returns exact gradients and proximal minimizers. For ε>0, the goal is a feasible output x¯ with F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈QF(x),F(x)=f(x)+ψ(x). Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product on E and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. The algorithm receives E, the starting point x0∈E, and the parameters H0,H1≥0,R,Δ,ε>0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and differentiability). The function f is convex and Fréchet differentiable on E. The set Q⊆E is convex, and ψ is convex on Q.

Assumption 2 (Minimizer and initialization). There exists x⋆∈Q such that x0∈Q and F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈Q,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ.

Assumption 3 (Gap-dependent upper model). For every x∈Q and y∈E satisfying H1∥y−x∥≤1, f(y)≤f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+(H0+H1(F(x)−F(x⋆)))∥y−x∥2.

Assumption 4 (Exact proximal access). There is a map P:R×E×E→E such that, for every a>0 and z,v∈E, P(a,z,v)∈argminu∈Q{∥u−z∥22a+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u)}.

The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. Gradient queries may use any x∈E. A proximal query (a,z,v)∈R×E×E returns P(a,z,v), with the minimization property above required for positive a. Gradient and proximal calls count toward a single total oracle-call budget.

After the allotted calls, the output must satisfy x¯∈Q,F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤εP-a.s.

comparisonHtml:
In a real Hilbert space E, minimize F=f+ψ over convex Q, with globally convex differentiable f and real-valued ψ convex on Q. Exact gradients and exact minimizers of ψ(u)+⟨v,u−z⟩+∥u−z∥2/(2a) over Q are available for every a>0,z,v. For x0,x⋆∈Q, assume x⋆∈arg⁡minQF, ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, and F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ, with H0,H1≥0 and R,Δ,ε>0. For every x∈Q and ambient y∈E with H1∥y−x∥≤1, assume f(y)≤f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+[H0+H1(F(x)−F(x⋆))]∥y−x∥2. Target: a deterministic x^∈Q with F(x^)−F(x⋆)≤ε.

Composite gap-curvature acceleration: CompositeGapSmooth.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) CompositeGapAccelerated (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O([1+RH0/ε+H1]ℓ⋅[1+log⁡(1+R2(H0/ε+H1))]) gradient plus prox calls.
(2) RCSAG (Lobanov et al. 2026), Thm. 9, noise-free specialization O([ℓ+RH0/ε+RH1ℓ](1+log⁡ℓ)) gradient calls; closed-form ball projections. Special case: Q=E=Rd, ψ=0, ε≤Δ. (1): Scope extends to nonsmooth composite objectives and constraints, including ∇f(x⋆)≠0, using ordinary prox calls. (1): Extra logarithmic factors on the smooth overlap, including the restart logarithm on RH0/ε.
(3) (LongTails 2026), repository result O(R(L0+L1G)/ε+(1+L1R)[1+log⁡(1+(1+L1R)Δ/(L0R2))]) gradient plus prox calls. Requires composite (L0,L1)-smoothness, L0>0, and ∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G. (1): Total-gap curvature replaces gradient-norm curvature; no G needed to stop. For the δ-family, ε=δ↓0: O(δ−3/2log2⁡(1/δ)) versus a startup term at least δ−2.
(4) Derived bound: Moreau smoothing + (Lobanov et al. 2026), Thm. 9 O([ℓ+R′H0/ε+R′Gψ/ε+R′H1ℓ](1+log⁡ℓ)) gradient plus prox calls. Requires Q=E=Rd, globally Gψ-Lipschitz ψ, Gψ>0, ε≤Δ, and a smoothed minimizer within known radius R′. (1): Removes R′Gψ/ε and the Lipschitz restriction. For R′=O(R), polynomial gain when Gψ/H0ε dominates logarithmic overhead and remaining terms; also covers constraints. (1): Extra logarithms. General total rates are not comparable without control of R′/R.
(5) (Lobanov 2026), Thm. 5 O(ℓ+R~H0/ε+R~H1ℓ) gradient, value, and exact segment-minimization calls, counting each segment solve once. Requires Q=E=Rd, ψ=0, finite R~, and ε≤F(x0)−F(x⋆). (1): Extends to composite constraints; needs only initial-distance radius R, no exact line search or function values. On this smooth restriction, prox updates are closed form. (1): Extra logarithmic factors when R~=O(R).

Abbr: ℓ=1+log⁡(1+Δ/ε). L0,L1 are gradient-norm smoothness constants; G bounds ∥∇f(x⋆)∥. Gψ is the Lipschitz constant of ψ; R′ bounds initial distance to a minimizer of f+ψλ, where ψλ is the Moreau envelope and λ=ε/Gψ2. R~=supf(x)≤f(x0)∥x−x⋆∥. The δ-family is f(x,y)=2eδycosh⁡x, ψ(x,y)=|x|+2δ|y|, Q=R2, x0=(0,1/δ), 0<δ≤1, with R=1/δ, Δ=2e, H0=2e, H1=e and L1≥1/δ.

import LongTails.Setups.CompositeGeneralizedSmooth
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

open Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.CompositeGapSmooth

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  H0 : ℝ
  H1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE

abbrev oraclePublic (p : Params) : CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Public where
  E := p.E
  L0 := p.H0
  L1 := p.H1
  R := p.R
  Δ := p.Δ
  x0 := p.x0

abbrev Instance (p : Params) := CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Instance (oraclePublic p)
abbrev Query (p : Params) := CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Query (oraclePublic p)

noncomputable def objective {p : Params} (I : Instance p) (x : p.E) : ℝ := I.f x + I.ψ x

def AmbientGapUpperModel {p : Params} (I : Instance p) (u : p.E) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ I.Q, ∀ y, Real.sqrt p.H1 * ‖y - x‖ ≤ 1 →
    I.f y ≤ I.f x + ⟪I.grad x, y - x⟫ +
      (p.H0 + p.H1 * (objective I x - objective I u)) * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2

structure Conditions (p : Params) (I : Instance p) (xstar : p.E) : Prop where
  convex_f : ConvexOn ℝ univ I.f
  gradient : ∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (I.grad x) x
  convex_domain : Convex ℝ I.Q
  convex_regularizer : ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.ψ
  prox : ∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ z v, I.prox a z v ∈ I.Q ∧
    IsMinOn (CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.proxObjective I a z v) I.Q (I.prox a z v)
  initial_feasible : p.x0 ∈ I.Q
  minimizer_feasible : xstar ∈ I.Q
  minimizer : IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar
  distance : ‖p.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ p.R
  gap : objective I p.x0 - objective I xstar ≤ p.Δ
  model : AmbientGapUpperModel I xstar

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 ≤ p.H0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.H1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p I O :=
    (∀ k seed x, O.answer k (0, .gradient x) seed = I.grad x) ∧
    (∀ k seed a z v, O.answer k (0, .prox a z v) seed = I.prox a z v) ∧
    ∃ xstar, Conditions p I xstar
  successful p I output P :=
    ∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _),
        output ω ∈ I.Q ∧ objective I (output ω) - objective I xstar ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.CompositeGapSmooth
